description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for verifying support for reading and manipulating Git configuration data stored in blobs within a Git repository. It uses test functions to check various scenarios around reading, writing, and error handling when working with configuration blobs in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs the provided shell commands, and reports failure if any command fails.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail; reports failure if the command succeeds.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a command output or file.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a Git commit with specific content, possibly with special characters.

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Runs a command outside of a Git repository context.
